  "reasons": [
    "For a credit balance (net profit), the supplied NCERT entry debits Profit and Loss A/c and credits Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c.",
    "The other choices give the net-loss entry, an interest-on-capital entry, or a different transaction."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Profit & Loss Appropriation Account",
  "syllabus_topic": "Journal entry for transferring net profit from Profit and Loss Account to Profit and Loss Appropriation Account",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,
  "question_type_match": true,
  "principle_applicability": "excerpt_required",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "The Profit and Loss Account has a credit balance (net profit).",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "The requested destination is the Profit and Loss Appropriation Account.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "For a credit-balance Profit and Loss Account, the transfer debits Profit and Loss A/c and credits Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": [
        "E1.2"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "strongest_reading": "A is the entry for a debit balance (net loss), but the stem specifies a credit balance (net profit).",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "It involves interest on capital, but the stem asks to transfer the Profit and Loss balance into Profit and Loss Appropriation.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "It could describe a later distribution to partners; the stem asks for transfer of the Profit and Loss balance into Appropriation.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [],
  "style_notes": [],
  "cuet_fit": {
    "criteria": {
      "syllabus_objective": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Profit and Loss Appropriation Account is named in the partnership unit; this tests its transfer entry."
      },
      "format_authenticity": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "A direct four-option conceptual MCQ, consistent with the supplied Accountancy exemplars."
      },
      "level_calibration": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "One-step entry recognition at the easy level represented by the conceptual exemplars."
      },
      "discrimination_value": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Distractors test confusion with the net-loss entry, interest on capital, and profit distribution."
      }
    },
    "reasoning_steps": 1,
    "estimated_difficulty": "easy",
    "cognitive_level": "application",
    "exemplar_ids_compared": [
      "cuet2024-accountancy-bookA-q6",
      "cuet2024-accountancy-bookA-q14"
    ]
  },
  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c Dr. To Profit and Loss A/c",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.2",
      "premise_quote": "(a) If Profit and Loss Account shows a credit balance (net profit):\nProfit and Loss A/c Dr.\nTo Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c\n(b) If Profit and Loss Account shows a debit balance (net loss)\nProfit and Loss Appropriation A/c Dr.\nTo Profit and Loss A/c",
      "reason": "That entry applies to a debit balance (net loss), whereas the stem gives a credit balance (net profit)."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.2",
      "premise_quote": "(a) If Profit and Loss Account shows a credit balance (net profit):\nProfit and Loss A/c Dr.\nTo Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c",
      "reason": "This is the supplied entry for transferring a credit balance (net profit)."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "To Interest on Capital A/c",
      "premise_source": "stem",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "Which journal entry transfers this balance to the Profit and Loss Appropriation Account?",
      "reason": "The entry credits Interest on Capital, not the requested Profit and Loss Appropriation Account."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c Dr. To Partners' Capital A/c",
      "premise_source": "stem",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "Which journal entry transfers this balance to the Profit and Loss Appropriation Account?",
      "reason": "It describes a different transaction and does not transfer the balance from Profit and Loss Account."
    }
  ]
}
